mainEntity.name: What should I consider when comparing painting contractors for my interior project?

acceptedAnswer.text: When comparing painting contractors, consider their experience, detailed scope of work, transparent pricing, and customer references. Look for contractors who provide a comprehensive proposal outlining surface preparation, paint types, and the number of coats. It's also important to check for proper licensing and insurance. For Frasheski Construction, our extensive experience in the East Bay area ensures we understand local housing styles and common issues, providing peace of mind that your project will be handled professionally and efficiently with a focus on quality craftsmanship.
